properties.description: Orchestrates ingestion followed by the Audit Log Processor, which writes copilot_interactions_curated before semantic-model refresh. Core: Audit log + Licensed Users always run; Org Data is optional via EnableOrgDataPull. The processor waits for audit log, licensed users and the Agents 365 branch (Graph API first, CSV fallback if the API step fails) to succeed. Optional sources (M365 activity, Dataverse transcripts, credit consumption, product feedback, Agents 365) are opt-in via their Enable* parameters (default false). Export-only sources (consumption, feedback) require their CSVs to be landed first (manually or via the flows in flows/). Semantic-model refresh is scheduled separately after pipeline success. See docs/PERMISSIONS.md for roles.

activities.name: Run_Audit_Log_Ingester
activities.description: Calls Microsoft Graph audit log API, polls until Purview is ready, fetches records, parses + flattens, writes Delta table dbo.copilot_interactions_parsed. Typical runtime 5-15 min.

activities.name: Run_Licensed_Users_Ingester
activities.description: Calls Microsoft Graph M365 active user report, derives HasCopilot flag, writes Delta table dbo.copilot_licensed_users. Typical runtime <30 sec.

activities.name: Run_Audit_Log_Processor
activities.description: Transforms copilot_interactions_parsed with licensed-user and available Agents 365 data into copilot_interactions_curated. Waits for the Agents 365 CSV fallback to succeed or be skipped, so a disabled source, a successful API pull or a successful CSV fallback all let processing continue. Refresh the semantic model only after pipeline success.

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_Org_Data
activities.description: Wraps the Org Data Ingester in an IfCondition so it only runs when EnableOrgDataPull = true. Customers who upload Entra/HRIS data manually can set this to false to skip the Graph pull.

ifTrueActivities.name: Run_Org_Data_Ingester
ifTrueActivities.description: Calls Microsoft Graph /users with manager expansion, writes Delta table dbo.copilot_org_data. Typical runtime <30 sec.

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_M365_Activity
activities.description: Optional. Runs the M365 Activity Ingester (Microsoft Graph usage reports for Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, OneDrive, Viva Engage and Microsoft 365 apps -> m365_activity_daily Delta table) only when EnableM365Activity = true. Needs Reports.Read.All, which the audit log ingester already uses. Loads the days not yet in the table and re-reads the most recent ones.

ifTrueActivities.name: Run_M365_Activity_Ingester
ifTrueActivities.description: Reads the six daily Microsoft 365 usage reports from Microsoft Graph and writes one row per person per day to Delta table dbo.m365_activity_daily. Typical runtime 2-10 min; the first run loads 28 days.

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_Dataverse_Transcripts
activities.description: Optional. Runs the Agent Transcript Parser (Dataverse conversationtranscripts -> agent_* Delta tables) only when EnableDataverse = true. Needs an app reg added as a Dataverse Application User with Read on Conversation Transcript (see docs/PERMISSIONS.md).

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_Credit_Consumption
activities.description: Optional. Runs the Credit Consumption Ingester (reads exported CSVs already in Files/credit_consumption/ -> credit_consumption_* Delta tables) only when EnableConsumption = true. Export-only source: the CSVs must already be landed (manually or via the Power Automate flow in flows/).

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_Product_Feedback
activities.description: Optional. Runs the Product Feedback Ingester (reads exported CSVs already in Files/product_feedback/ -> user_feedback Delta table) only when EnableProductFeedback = true. Export-only source: the CSVs must already be landed (manually or via the Power Automate flow in flows/).

activities.name: Conditionally_Run_Agent365
activities.description: Optional. When EnableAgent365 = true, runs the Agent 365 Registry Ingester (Graph API -> agents_365 Delta table), the primary source. Needs an Agent 365 licence and admin-consented CopilotPackages.Read.All + Application.Read.All + User.Read.All. If it fails (for example 403 with no Agent 365 licence), Run_Agent365_CSV_Fallback lands the exported CSV instead.

activities.name: Run_Agent365_CSV_Fallback
activities.description: Fallback for tenants without Agent 365 API access. Runs the Agents 365 Lander (Files/agent365/agents.csv -> agents_365) only when Conditionally_Run_Agent365 fails; skipped otherwise. If no CSV is present it keeps the existing agents_365 snapshot and succeeds. The processor proceeds when this activity succeeds or is skipped.
